Will Sensex, Nifty fall today as Iran war escalation pushes crude oil above $90?Markets are set for a cautious start as rising crude prices and renewed US-Iran hostilities weigh on sentiment. MSCI rebalancing and HDFC Bank's looming leadership change could keep trading volatile through the day.

My borrowing is zero: Subhash Chandra clarifies on Rs 22,000-crore caseThe controversy pertains to an NCLT order approving a resolution plan under which Subhash Chandra would pay around Rs 6.5 crore against admitted claims of approximately Rs 22,006 crore.

From Archies cards to Air Jordans: How India's gifting culture is changingFrom handwritten Archies cards and Rs 101 shagun envelopes to branded sneakers and curated hampers, India's idea of the perfect gift has evolved. How did we get here, and what does it say about the India we live in today?

HDFC Bank CEO Sashidhar Jagdishan to step down when term ends in OctoberThe announcement of Jagdishan's exit comes months after Atanu Chakraborty resigned as the bank's part-time chairman in March, citing ethical differences. His departure had raised concerns among investors over the bank's internal governance.

Data centres are India's new AI infrastructure. But what's in it for jobs?India is rapidly expanding data-centre capacity to back its AI ambitions. The bigger jobs story may lie in the wider ecosystem these facilities enable.

Subhash Chandra accuses Mukesh Ambani of media campaign against him, Reliance calls it baselessReliance said it holds Subhash Chandra 'in high regard as a businessman and entrepreneur' and wished him well. In a video message, he directly addressed Mukesh Ambani and questioned the coverage of his personal insolvency proceedings.

I'll earn again: Subhash Chandra plans career in Switzerland after debt payoutSubhash Chandra defended his personal insolvency proceedings and disputed the Rs 22,006 crore claims figure. He said the amount arose from personal guarantees for group loans and sought an independent audit of repayments.

CNG price hiked by Rs 3.89 in Delhi-NCR. Check new ratesDelhi CNG prices have risen by Rs 3.89 per kg to Rs 86.98 from August 29, as IGL increased rates across all its geographical areas from 6 am amid the ongoing Middle East crisis.

Infosys executive Lax Gopisetty missing after deadly Nepal flash floodsInfosys said its Infosys Public Services chief Lax Gopisetty remains unreachable after flash floods in Nepal, where he was visiting personally. Sebi clears Rs 37,000 crore Jio IPO, set to become India's biggest listingAt the estimated issue size of about Rs 37,700 crore (USD 3.8 billion), the offering would surpass Hyundai Motor India's USD 3.3 billion-equivalent listing in 2024 and become the largest IPO in India.

FDA cancels Cipla Pune unit's licence over Reactin Plus violations; firm contestsThe cancellation came into effect on August 27, following an inspection of the company's main warehouse at Wadki in Pune district, according to the FDA.

Mumbai milk prices to rise by Rs 9 from September 1 ahead of festive seasonMumbai milk producers have raised tabela milk prices by Rs 9 per litre from September 1, 2026. The increase, ahead of the festive season, is linked to higher cattle, feed and fodder costs.

SP Group seeks Tata Sons stake deal as lenders demand a clear exitShapoorji Pallonji (SP) Group and Tata Group are discussing options around the sale of part of SP's Tata Sons stake. Lenders want visible progress on monetisation as the group faces repayments and costly debt.

Sensex, Nifty snap losing run as IT stocks rally, end week lower for 3rd timeThe BSE Sensex gained 330.92 points, or 0.43%, to close at 77,264.51, while the Nifty 50 rose 84.80 points, or 0.35%, to 24,175.65.

Rs 22,000 cr claims, Rs 6.25 cr payout: Who backed Subhash Chandra's pay plan?The NCLT (National Company Law Tribunal) order shows that creditors representing 80.814% of the votes cast backed Chandra's plan, while others, including HDFC Bank and LIC Housing Finance, voted against it. Sensex opens 200 points higher, Nifty above 24,100; IT stocks rallyThe BSE Sensex opened at 77,128.05, up 194.46 points from the previous close of 76,933.59, and was trading at 77,225.85, up 292.26 points or 0.38%, around 9:32 am. The Nifty50 opened at 24,122.60 and was at 24,143.95, up 53.10 points or 0.22%, around the same time.

Companies are giving AI more control. Is cybersecurity ready for it?Companies are giving AI systems greater access to enterprise identities, data and tools. That is pushing cybersecurity teams to track AI behaviour, intent and actions in context.

entertainment.headline: Samantha and Raj's fans have baby names ready for them. Actor's reply is gold Samantha Ruth Prabhu laughed off a fan's 'Samraj' baby-name suggestion after sharing new pregnancy photos. The actor and her filmmaker, husband Raj Nidimoru, are expecting their first child in December.

Rs 10 lakh on Day 1, Rs 47 crore in 24 days: Hanuman Ansh's wild box office run Director Vishal Chaturvedi's devotional film, Hanuman Ansh, has surged from a Rs 10 lakh opening to Rs 47.33 crore India gross in 24 days. Actor Manasi Parekh returns home safely after Nepal floods, shares ordeal Actor Manasi Parekh has safely returned to Mumbai after a harrowing journey through flood-affected areas in Tibet and Nepal during her Kailash Mansarovar pilgrimage with Sadhguru's Isha Foundation. She shared her emotional ordeal and gratitude for the support received while many others remain missing in the devastating flash floods.

Sonam Wangchuk has a cheeky response to Salman Khan's viral 'it's done bro' remark Remember Salman Khan's 'Sonam, it's done bro' moment? Sonam Wangchuk has now responded to the actor's viral remark, bringing the much-discussed exchange back into the spotlight.

Ravi Teja, Tollywood's Mass Maharaja, scores first Rs 150-crore grosser with Irumudi Telugu cinema's Mass Maharaja Ravi Teja's Irumudi crossed the Rs 150-crore mark worldwide within 10 days and reached an estimated Rs 170.95 crore after Day 10. The film's steady second-week run marks a major box-office comeback for the actor.

Daboo Malik backs son Amaal amid Awarapan 2 row, says negativity was spread Daboo Malik has publicly backed son Amaal Mallik after the controversy over Yeh Awarapan from Awarapan 2. His post follows online criticism, Amaal's paid PR claim and his decision to take a temporary break from film music.

Rajkumar Santoshi rejects Shabana Azmi's theory that Batwara failed over Muslim hero Rajkumar Santoshi has rejected Shabana Azmi's claim that Batwara 1947 failed because Sunny Deol plays a Muslim character. Their exchange has renewed focus on audience confusion, faith and the film's weak box office run.

Toxic box office Day 5: Rs 300 crore in sight, but Yash film loses steam Yash's Toxic: A Fairy Tale For Grown-Ups is nearing Rs 300 crore worldwide after five days, even as its first Sunday saw its lowest India nett collection so far.

Priyanka-Nick live out 90s fan dreams at Backstreet Boys Vegas concert. Watch Actor Priyanka Chopra and singer Nick Jonas spent their Las Vegas night at a Backstreet Boys concert, dancing and singing along from the balcony. Videos from their outing have emerged online.

Rashmika Mandanna to resume work soon after hip injury, shares update Actor Rashmika Mandanna has said she will return to work soon after recovering from a hip injury suffered during Mysaa. The update also offers a glimpse into her quiet break at home before she resumes a packed film schedule.

Don't shun Nepal: Manisha Koirala urges tourists as nation grapples with flood Actor Manisha Koirala urged the international community to keep visiting Nepal despite the calamity on the Nepal-Tibet border. The actor mentioned how the country needs tourism.

Did Orry quit KKK 15? Emotional post after injury sparks exit buzz Social media sensation Orry shared a video after a stunt on Khatron Ke Khiladi 15, showing others helping him as he hinted at defeat. His emotional note has sparked speculation over his exit.

YouTuber Rajat Dalal rams Thar into car blocking parking exit, shares video YouTuber Rajat Dalal posted videos showing his Thar hitting a car after he said it blocked him in Faridabad parking. He said the problem happens regularly and denied the clips were scripted or promotional.

Zara Larsson says she is not a new artist for the Grammys Swedish singer and songwriter Zara Larsson rejected a 2027 Grammys Best New Artist submission, arguing the category would overlook her 13-year career despite the resurgence driven by Midnight Sun.

Rajkumar Santoshi-Sunny Deol to reunite for Ghatak Ghus Ke Maarega after Batwara 1947 Director Rajkumar Santoshi has confirmed that he and Sunny Deol are reuniting for Ghatak Ghus Ke Maarega, with the actor reprising his Ghatak character in a new setting.

Nikki Tamboli responds after Arbaz Patel accuses her of cheating in cryptic post Actor Arbaz Patel shared a message on infidelity, and actor Nikki Tamboli followed with a cryptic note on affairs. Their social media posts have intensified speculation over the status of their relationship.

Mirzapur The Movie: Ali Fazal-Pankaj Tripathi film gets A certificate, runtime out Mirzapur: The Movie has received an 'A' certificate ahead of its September 4 theatrical release. The film is slated to release in theatres on September 4.

Actor Chandrachur Singh files case against aunt, cousins over alleged forged will Actor Chandrachur Singh has lodged an FIR accusing relatives of forging his grandfather's will. The complaint says the disputed document deprived his late father of inheritance rights.

Sonam Wangchuk hits back at Aamir Khan's 'never met' claim with witty Ghajini jibe Activist Sonam Wangchuk has said that he and actor Aamir Khan had met and discussed ideas before 3 Idiots. His Ghajini quip revived the dispute over whether that exchange influenced Phunsuk Wangdu.

Indian, Chinese and Nepali rescue teams are searching hydropower tunnels for trapped workers, while China's Xi Jinping has ordered intensified efforts to find survivors.

Bangladesh sees 'no risk' in joining Mecca Pact: Muslim family's internal matterBangladesh says it would positively consider joining the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement if invited. The statement came days after Foreign Minister Khalilur Rahman told Parliament that Bangladesh would positively consider joining the pact if invited, and said it was an internal matter of "our Muslim family" with no scope for others to be concerned about it.

Nepal saw the risk, sought early warning from China. Disaster struck weeks laterNepal sought more data from China on glacier movements, water levels and extreme events three months before flash floods ravaged its border with Tibet. Beijing said it had shared information in a timely manner, as Kathmandu now seeks more frequent warnings to prepare for future disasters.

Why Dimple Yadav could be Akhilesh's biggest weapon against BJP in 2027 UP pollsTo counter allegations of dynastic politics, Samajwadi Party leader Akhilesh Yadav once pledged that his wife Dimple Yadav would not contest another election. Nine years later, Mainpuri MP Dimple is not only in the political game, she is playing a crucial role. Can Dimple become Akhilesh's ace in 2027?

Very country Babur came from: Owaisi jabs BJP over PM Modi's Uzbekistan honourOwaisi questioned the Sangh Parivar's repeated references to Babur, urging its supporters to reconsider invoking the Mughal emperor after Uzbekistan, his place of origin, honoured PM Modi.

No limit to imagination: DMK, Congress push back against 'Vijay For PM' pitchThe Congress and DMK hit out at the growing 'Vijay for PM in 2029' narrative, while TVK supporters even put up posters backing his 2029 prime ministerial bid.

Police have arrested both men, seized the sleeper bus and sent it for a forensic examination.

How a Bengaluru teen turned a lockdown drone project into a $37 million startupAirbound has raised $37 million in a Series A round led by Greenoaks as founder Naman Pushp expands its drone logistics business. What began during lockdown, when a young Naman built a drone out of boredom, has now grown into a headline-making startup.

Iran retaliates against US forces in Jordan after attack on Larak Island launchersUS forces targeted two Iranian launchers on Larak Island after IRGC forces were seen preparing to launch rockets carrying sea mines into the Strait of Hormuz. In response, Iran attacked US bases in Jordan with ballistic missiles.

Live: Death toll reaches 903 as rescue efforts continueNepal Flash Flood Live Updates: Nepal's flood death toll has risen to 903, while 2,426 people remain missing as rescue operations intensify at the Trishuli-3A hydropower project tunnel, where several people are feared trapped. A specialised Silkyara tunnel rescue team has reached Nepal to assist, while Kathmandu has sought technical support for tunnel rescue, transport links, body identification and preservation, and requested Bailey bridges from India and China. Rescue operations have been hampered by rain and grounded helicopters, with authorities also monitoring the Bhote Koshi and Trishuli rivers and a temporary lake near the flood source in Tibet. India has rescued 84 citizens, while around 320 remain missing or uncontactable; 106 tourists from Maharashtra have returned home. Nepal has thanked India for its assistance and said billions of dollars could be required to rebuild infrastructure damaged by the floods, including roads, bridges and hydropower projects.

Elon Musk claims AI will become superhuman next year, will do all things digitalTech trillionaire Elon Musk believes that AI is going to get better, fast. So much so, Musk says that next year, we may see AI become superhuman when it comes to digital tasks.

52% more pay: Why MBA graduates are earning more than engineers in the job marketThe future of work is moving beyond the old engineering-versus-MBA divide. As AI takes over more technical tasks, the premium is shifting towards people who can connect technology with business, make sound decisions and lead through change. The real advantage may belong to those who can bridge both worlds.

Why global brands taste and feel different in IndiaIndian consumers are discovering that global food, drink and personal care brands often sell different formulations here. Fanta tastes sweeter and the formula of Head & Shoulders is different. Here's why products by the same brands taste, smell and feel different in India and abroad.

Rajasthan family turns expressway into picnic spot, sits down for lunch on roadA video of a family eating a meal on a Rajasthan expressway has gone viral online. The clip has drawn criticism over civic sense and the use of public infrastructure.

15.6 kg of gold worth Rs 25 crore seized from woman near Bengal-Bangladesh borderBSF personnel detained a woman in Nadia's Banpur border area after a prolonged vigil and recovered 15.607 kg of gold from her. The seizure has triggered a wider probe into the source, recipient and possible cross-border smuggling network.

Bengaluru woman says corporate life is school with salaries, exams every MondayA video shared by a Bengaluru-based professional likened corporate life to an endless school examination. Her account of pending work, weekend anxiety and last-minute panic resonated with many viewers online.

Mumbai woman runs over 8-year-old boy while talking on phone; arrestedAn eight-year-old boy was run over by an Innova Crysta while crossing John Baptist Road in Bandra West on Sunday. Police arrested the driver, Megha Rawal, as investigators examined allegations of speeding and phone distraction.

Babar Azam denies Lord's Test boycott plan over Imran Khan interviewPakistan Test captain Babar Azam has denied knowledge of any discussion about the team refusing to return after lunch at Lord's. sports.headline: Five sets against GOAT: Navone savours career-defining US Open win vs Djokovic Argentine Mariano Navone was lost for words after pulling off the biggest win of his career, stunning Novak Djokovic 6-7(5), 7-5, 6-4, 2-6, 1-6 in a gruelling five-set first-round clash at the US Open. The defeat ended Djokovic's bid for a record 25th Grand Slam crown.

Jude Bellingham thriving in freer Real Madrid role under Jose Mourinho Jude Bellingham said he is enjoying the freedom Jose Mourinho has given him at Real Madrid. His display against Málaga underlined his strong start and the growing fluency in Madrid's attack.

Daniil Medvedev, Jessica Pegula make winning starts at US Open Daniil Medvedev and Jessica Pegula opened their US Open campaigns with straight-set wins in New York. The results offered Medvedev relief after a poor lead-up and kept Pegula's strong season on track.

Arun Dhumal set to be re-elected unopposed to IPL Governing CouncilArun Singh Dhumal and Khairul Jamal Majumdar are set to be re-elected unopposed to the IPL Governing Council at the BCCI AGM on September 18.
